title: Internet service disruption - Malua Bay, NSW
current_summary:
One service in Malua Bay, NSW was affected from 10:50 pm AEDT on 24 October 2026. Service was restored at 1:47 pm AEDT on 25 October 2026.

Remote troubleshooting indicates an unplanned local power outage is affecting the nbn network causing a loss of service to customers. The backup battery power at the site has been depleted. Field services will attend the site to deploy a generator as an alternate power source during the ongoing power outage. Further updates will be provided as more information, or an ETA, becomes available.

Resolution: Fault caused by approved 3rd party network provider planned works

Services in your area have been restored following an unexpected network issue. If your service has not reconnected automatically, try restarting your Wi-Fi router and nbn Connection Box (if you have one).

cause.reason: Local power outage affecting the network site
cause.detailed: An unplanned local power outage is affecting the network site, and the backup battery power has been depleted.
